newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SNB keeps discount rate at one pct after meeting.
newsitem.headline: SNB keeps discount rate at one pct after meeting.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank said it left its discount rate unchanged at 1.00 percent after a regular weekly meeting of its council.
"No change," an SNB spokesman said in response to an enquiry.
Markets had not expected a change in the rate, which was last lowered on September 26.

At current levels, the rate matches the historic low maintained from February 1978 to November 1979. The discount rate sets the effective floor for Swiss short-term rates but has largely psychological significance. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
